items.title: Federal Labor MP Luke Gosling charged with assault
items.description: Federal Labor MP Luke Gosling has been charged with assaulting NT Administrator David Connolly at a Thai festival earlier this month.

items.title: Online watchdog takes Telegram to court over terrorism videos
items.description: The Office of the eSafety Commissioner will allege Telegram neglected its legal obligations when it allowed videos, including of the Christchurch mosque massacre, to remain on the platform.

items.title: Optus sued in Federal Court over network outage
items.description: The Australian Communications and Media Authority is suing Optus in the Federal Court over last year's network outage in which hundreds of calls failed to reach Triple Zero.

items.title: Tasmanian producer pulls products after Four Corners report
items.description: The labels on some of Tasmanian producer Stuart Young's handcrafted goods say some ingredients may come from "further afield". But that was a reference to the Australian mainland, not China.

items.title: Teacher used laptop decorated with a 'free Palestine' sticker, inquiry told
items.description: Antisemitism in schools and against young people has been a key focus of the Royal Commission on Antisemitism and Social Cohesion in Sydney today.

items.title: The everyday items that have gone up in price — and what's gone down
items.description: The good news this week is inflation has eased slightly. The bad news is it remains stubbornly high. So we've tracked how the prices of everyday items have changed.

items.title: Youths allegedly punched, choked and threatened by police, report reveals
items.description: Victoria's commissioner for children and young people is urging the state's new premier to tackle crime with a more preventative approach following a report looking into youth offenders.

items.title: New Alzheimer's test could give results in as little as 18 minutes
items.description: The ability to diagnose Alzheimer's decades earlier could be a step closer with a new blood test set for clinical trials within months.

items.title: US strikes 'dozens of targets' in Iran as war threatens to engulf Middle East
items.description: America's military strikes "dozens" of Revolutionary Guard targets across Iran, as the spread of hostilities to Egypt, Iraq and Saudi Arabia threatens to plunge the rest of the Middle East into all-out conflict.

items.title: With a Caspian Sea strike, Zelenskyy showed Trump he was a 'winner'
items.description: A large inland sea connecting military supply lines through Russia and Iran could now be a pivotal theatre for two major wars that are usually thought of as separate.

items.title: Woman faces legal action over video of driver in racist road rage incident
items.description: A woman who filmed a Provac Australia driver making an apparent racist gesture to her rideshare driver faces legal action from a company directed by a former One Nation candidate.

items.title: Portrait of Jewish advocate wins Archibald Prize People's Choice Award
items.description: Michael Zavros has won the Archibald Prize People's Choice Award for a portrait of Alex Ryvchin.

items.title: K-pop powerhouse BTS announces 2027 Grammy boycott
items.description: One month after an Asian pop category was added to the Grammy Awards line-up, BTS announced it would not submit music to the 2027 show.

items.title: Cricketer dubbed 'Clicky Ponting' suspended as stats show unusual trend
items.description: The club at the centre of the '"Clicky Ponting" amateur cricket scandal suspends the player allegedly involved, as data shows dramatic increases in catches when he has played.

items.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is the return of the mid-tier Marvel movie
items.description: Tom Holland's return as a now-anonymous Peter Parker isn't the igniting spark Marvel needs to revive its cinematic universe.

items.title: Six artworks to see at the newly reopened Brett Whiteley Studio
items.description: An Archibald winner, an intimate portrait of a marriage and a suburban backyard are among the Brett Whiteley artworks on display at his renovated studio.

items.title: Two-decade-old Toyota Corolla stuns Gibb River Road onlookers
items.description: Jonny Charles is venturing across the famous Kimberley four-wheel-drive track in a 2002 Toyota Corolla, selling coffees out of his boot to fund the trip.

items.title: PNG landowners blockade water repair site, saying 'we have an issue'
items.description: Urgent repairs to address a pending water crisis in Papua New Guinea's capital are being delayed after traditional landowners set up a blockade.

items.title: Residents at homeless shelter plead for help to save their homes
items.description: Hundreds of adults and children living at Darwin's largest homeless shelter have been told they need to be out by October — and many fear they won't have anywhere to go.

items.title: CFMEU commissioner accuses Qld police of taking side of 'law-breakers'
items.description: Commissioner Stuart Wood took aim at the police response to a 2024 CFMEU blockade in which he said police "took the side of law-breakers".

items.title: Victorian premier apologises to victim-survivors of child sexual abuse in schools
items.description: Victorian Premier Ben Carroll formally apologises to victim-survivors of child sexual abuse in state government schools, describing a "terrible reality" of systemic failures.

items.title: 'Why only 12 hours?': Mother of man shot by police cautiously welcomes change
items.description: People experiencing mental health emergencies in New South Wales will be met by healthcare workers as opposed to police, under a new model being rolled out by the state government.

items.title: Deadly H5N1 bird flu strain detected in Victoria for first time
items.description: The deadly H5N1 bird flu strain has reached Victoria, a positive test of a bird in the state's south-west has confirmed.

items.title: Pharmaceutical company bows to pressure, offers life-saving drug for free
items.description: Breast cancer patients were considering removing their ovaries until the maker of Zoladex 3.6mg said they would give the drug away rather than list it on the PBS.

items.title: Liberals registered dead and ex-members as preselectors for key seat
items.description: A leaked Liberal Party spreadsheet has revealed that one dead person and two ex-members were registered as preselectors for a vote in a key seat for the upcoming Victorian election.
